ranking.zh:
我们沿用 RBM-EVAL-OOD 的轨迹质量排序评测方式[[cite:robometer]][[cite:rbm]]：对轨迹独立评分，并用 Kendall τa 衡量同一任务内评分顺序与“成功 > 次优 > 失败”参考顺序的一致性。零样本条件下，gpt-6-astra、GPT-5.6-sol 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 分别达到 0.8166、0.7500 和 0.5300。三种通用多模态模型都表现出质量区分能力，但具体识别能力存在明显的差异；gpt-6-astra 在本次评测中展现出最佳的轨迹质量区分能力。

gpt-6-astra 和 GPT-5.6-sol 的排序分数还高于专用模型 RynnValue-8B（0.675）[[cite:rynnvalue]]和 Robometer（0.655）[[cite:robometer]]的报告结果。

Case Study：区分抽屉关合与仍然敞开

xArm 的关抽屉任务中，A 的参考标签为成功，B 为失败。gpt-6-astra 分别给出分数 1.00 和 0.00，正确区分了两条轨迹的质量；DeepSeek 的对应分数为 0.20 和 0.30，顺序与参考相反。

同任务的独立评分；分数范围 0–1。A/B 仅用于本文区分轨迹，模型每次单独看一段。
轨迹 / 参考标签gpt-6-astraDeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
A · 成功1.000.20
B · 失败0.000.30

输入帧中，A 的抽屉前面板被推回，最后不再露出抽屉内部；B 最后仍明显敞开。gpt-6-astra 指出了这一最终状态差异。DeepSeek 却称 A 的抽屉仍处于初始打开位置。

查看两模型的逐字理由
gpt-6-astra · A · 1.00
The robot pushes the protruding drawer inward until its front is flush with the cabinet frame and the open top is no longer visible. The final frames show the drawer closed.
gpt-6-astra · B · 0.00
The drawer remains extended with its open interior clearly visible in the final frames. The robot gripper enters the drawer, but no sustained closing motion or closed final state is shown.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · A · 0.20
The robot arm approaches and may contact the drawer handle, but the drawer remains in its initial open position; no visible closing motion or flush final state is achieved.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · B · 0.30
Drawer moves slightly toward closed after initial handle contact, but remains visibly open in the final frame; no complete closure achieved.

Case Study：搬的是香蕉，还是橙色物体

MIT Franka 的任务要求把香蕉从蓝盘移到绿盘。A 的参考标签为成功，B 为次优；gpt-6-astra 的独立分数是 A 1.00 > B 0.00，符合参考顺序。DeepSeek 给出 A 0.50 < B 1.00，形成反序。

同任务的独立评分；分数范围 0–1。A/B 仅用于本文区分轨迹，模型每次单独看一段。
轨迹 / 参考标签gpt-6-astraDeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
A · 成功1.000.50
B · 次优0.001.00

A 的末帧显示香蕉已到绿盘边缘，B 搬到绿盘的则是橙色物体，香蕉仍留在蓝盘。gpt-6-astra 区分了目标物体；DeepSeek 却认为 B 中搬运的是香蕉。

查看两模型的逐字理由
gpt-6-astra · A · 1.00
The robot grasps the banana from the blue plate, carries it to the green plate, and opens its gripper. The final frame shows the banana resting on the green plate near its rim, with the carrot left behind.
gpt-6-astra · B · 0.00
The robot grasps and releases the orange object onto the green plate, not the banana. The yellow banana remains on the blue plate in the final frame, so the requested transfer is not completed.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · A · 0.50
The robot correctly picks the banana (not the carrot) from the blue plate and moves it toward the green plate. However, the final frame shows the banana still held/at the green plate edge rather than clearly released and resting on the green plate; placement is incomplete.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · B · 1.00
The robot grasps the banana from the blue plate, lifts it, and releases it onto the green plate; the final frame shows the banana resting on the green plate.

gpt-6-astra 的排序错误：逆序与平分

Case Study：搬错物体与抬盘失误

任务要求把香蕉从蓝盘移到绿盘。一条执行搬走了胡萝卜，香蕉仍在蓝盘、绿盘为空，gpt-6-astra 给出 0.00；另一条抬起并倾斜蓝盘，香蕉滑落，未放到绿盘，却得到 0.15。模型已指出两次执行都没有完成目标，但参考将前者标为次优、后者标为失败，因此分数顺序与参考相反。

同一任务下的独立轨迹评分
轨迹参考质量gpt-6-astra 评分
搬动胡萝卜次优0.00
抬盘后香蕉掉落失败0.15

分歧出现在对两种未完成行为的相对评价，而不是是否发现目标没有完成。

查看模型原文
搬动胡萝卜：0.00
The robot picks up the orange carrot rather than the yellow banana and releases it to the right of the green plate. The banana remains on the blue plate, and the green plate is empty.
抬盘后香蕉滑落：0.15
The robot approaches the banana but appears to lift and tilt the blue plate instead of grasping the banana. The banana slides or falls off to the right; no placement or release onto the green plate is visible.

Case Study：开盖后，两种质量都得满分

在打开蓝色垃圾桶的两条轨迹中，参考分别标为成功和次优，gpt-6-astra 却都给出 1.00。它对成功执行的理由是桶盖已抬起、内部明显露出；对次优执行也依据桶盖下方出现开口，判断正确的桶已打开。这里的失分来自同分：模型识别到开盖这一共同结果，却没有在分数中区分质量等级。

查看模型原文
参考成功：1.00
The left gripper lifts the blue bin's lid, leaving its dark interior visibly exposed in the final frames. The red and green bins remain closed.
参考次优：1.00
The left gripper lifts the blue bin’s lid, leaving a visible opening beneath it in the final frame. The correct bin is opened; the red and green bins remain closed.
ranking.en:
We follow RBM-EVAL-OOD’s trajectory quality ranking protocol[[cite:robometer]][[cite:rbm]]: score trajectories independently and use Kendall τa to measure agreement with the reference order “successful > suboptimal > failure” within each task. In the zero-shot setting, gpt-6-astra, GPT-5.6-sol, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash achieve 0.8166, 0.7500, and 0.5300, respectively. All three general-purpose multimodal models distinguish execution quality, but their recognition capabilities differ substantially; gpt-6-astra shows the strongest trajectory quality discrimination in this evaluation.

The ranking scores of gpt-6-astra and GPT-5.6-sol also exceed the reported results for the specialized models RynnValue-8B (0.675)[[cite:rynnvalue]] and Robometer (0.655)[[cite:robometer]].

Case Study: distinguishing a closed drawer from one left open

In the xArm drawer-closing task, A is labeled successful and B is labeled failure. gpt-6-astra assigns scores of 1.00 and 0.00, correctly distinguishing the quality of the two trajectories; DeepSeek assigns 0.20 and 0.30, reversing the reference order.

Independent scores for the same task, on a 0–1 scale. A/B distinguish trajectories in this article; each scoring request contains one video.
Trajectory / reference labelgpt-6-astraDeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
A · success1.000.20
B · failure0.000.30

In the input frames, A’s drawer front is pushed back and the drawer interior is no longer visible at the end; B remains clearly open. gpt-6-astra identifies this final-state difference. DeepSeek instead claims that A’s drawer remains in its initial open position.

Read both models’ original reasons
gpt-6-astra · A · 1.00
The robot pushes the protruding drawer inward until its front is flush with the cabinet frame and the open top is no longer visible. The final frames show the drawer closed.
gpt-6-astra · B · 0.00
The drawer remains extended with its open interior clearly visible in the final frames. The robot gripper enters the drawer, but no sustained closing motion or closed final state is shown.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · A · 0.20
The robot arm approaches and may contact the drawer handle, but the drawer remains in its initial open position; no visible closing motion or flush final state is achieved.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · B · 0.30
Drawer moves slightly toward closed after initial handle contact, but remains visibly open in the final frame; no complete closure achieved.

Case Study: transferring the banana or the orange object

The MIT Franka task asks for the banana to be moved from the blue plate to the green plate. A is labeled successful and B suboptimal. gpt-6-astra’s independent scores, A 1.00 > B 0.00, match that order; DeepSeek’s A 0.50 < B 1.00 reverse it.

Independent scores for the same task, on a 0–1 scale. A/B distinguish trajectories in this article; each scoring request contains one video.
Trajectory / reference labelgpt-6-astraDeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
A · success1.000.50
B · suboptimal0.001.00

A’s final frame shows the banana at the green plate’s rim. B moves the orange object to the green plate while leaving the banana on the blue plate. gpt-6-astra distinguishes the target object; DeepSeek instead treats the object moved in B as the banana.

Read both models’ original reasons
gpt-6-astra · A · 1.00
The robot grasps the banana from the blue plate, carries it to the green plate, and opens its gripper. The final frame shows the banana resting on the green plate near its rim, with the carrot left behind.
gpt-6-astra · B · 0.00
The robot grasps and releases the orange object onto the green plate, not the banana. The yellow banana remains on the blue plate in the final frame, so the requested transfer is not completed.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · A · 0.50
The robot correctly picks the banana (not the carrot) from the blue plate and moves it toward the green plate. However, the final frame shows the banana still held/at the green plate edge rather than clearly released and resting on the green plate; placement is incomplete.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · B · 1.00
The robot grasps the banana from the blue plate, lifts it, and releases it onto the green plate; the final frame shows the banana resting on the green plate.

gpt-6-astra’s ranking errors: inversions and ties

Case Study: moving the wrong object and tilting the plate

The task asks the robot to move the banana from the blue plate to the green plate. One execution moves the carrot, leaving the banana on the blue plate and the green plate empty; gpt-6-astra gives it 0.00. Another lifts and tilts the blue plate, causing the banana to fall without reaching the green plate, yet receives 0.15. The model identifies that neither execution completes the goal, but the reference labels the former suboptimal and the latter failure, so the scores reverse the reference order.

Independent scores for executions of the same task
TrajectoryReference qualitygpt-6-astra score
Moving the carrotSuboptimal0.00
Banana falls after the plate is liftedFailure0.15

The disagreement concerns the relative assessment of two incomplete behaviors, rather than whether the model notices that the goal is incomplete.

Read the original model responses
Moving the carrot: 0.00
The robot picks up the orange carrot rather than the yellow banana and releases it to the right of the green plate. The banana remains on the blue plate, and the green plate is empty.
Banana slips after the plate is tilted: 0.15
The robot approaches the banana but appears to lift and tilt the blue plate instead of grasping the banana. The banana slides or falls off to the right; no placement or release onto the green plate is visible.

Case Study: different quality, the same full score

For two trajectories that open the blue trash bin, the reference labels one successful and the other suboptimal, yet gpt-6-astra gives both 1.00. For the successful execution, it cites the raised lid and clearly exposed interior; for the suboptimal one, it also treats the opening beneath the lid as evidence that the correct bin has been opened. The lost credit comes from a tie: the model recognizes the shared opening outcome but does not distinguish quality levels in its scores.

Read the original model responses
Reference success: 1.00
The left gripper lifts the blue bin's lid, leaving its dark interior visibly exposed in the final frames. The red and green bins remain closed.
Reference suboptimal: 1.00
The left gripper lifts the blue bin’s lid, leaving a visible opening beneath it in the final frame. The correct bin is opened; the red and green bins remain closed.

preference.zh:
直接偏好判断将两条轨迹同时提供给模型，要求选择更好的执行。在 1,192 组固定轨迹对上，gpt-6-astra、GPT-5.6-sol 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的准确率分别为 92.4%、90.7% 和 82.2%。gpt-6-astra 与 GPT-5.6-sol 的差距为 1.7 个百分点。作为参照，Robometer 报告的准确率为 82.5%[[cite:robometer]]。

在下面的 case study中，gpt-6-astra 与 DeepSeek 接收相同的任务、图像和 A/B 顺序。

Case Study：按键亮起，比末帧停留更有说服力

SO101 的按按钮配对中，实际输入 A 为次优，B 为成功，参考偏好为 B。gpt-6-astra 选择 B，DeepSeek 选择 A。

B 的输入帧显示夹爪下压后按钮亮起，随后撤回；A 在按钮附近停留，但没有同样清晰的亮起证据。gpt-6-astra 依据激活状态选择 B。DeepSeek 则强调 A 在末帧仍接触按钮、B 已撤回，因此选择相反。

查看两模型的逐字理由
gpt-6-astra · 实际选择 B
B lowers its gripper onto the button, which visibly lights up, then retracts. A approaches the button but shows no clear depression or activation.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · 实际选择 A
In A, the gripper descends onto the button and remains in contact with it at the final frame, indicating a press. In B, the gripper approaches the button but then retracts, leaving the button without clear sustained contact/pressing at the end.

Case Study：打开过桶盖，不等于最后仍然打开

Koch 的打开红色垃圾桶配对中，实际输入 A 为失败，B 为成功，参考偏好为 B。gpt-6-astra 选择 B，符合参考；DeepSeek 选择 A，与参考相反。

两段输入都出现抬盖动作，但 A 在倒数第二张采样图中打开后，最后一张又合上；B 的最后一张仍显示桶盖抬起和桶内开口。gpt-6-astra 明确指出 A 的回落。DeepSeek 则将 A 描述为最终保持打开，并因 B 的夹爪仍在开口附近而降低对其的评价。

查看两模型的逐字理由
gpt-6-astra · 实际选择 B
Both executions lift the correct red bin's lid, but A's lid falls closed again in its final frame. B ends with the lid raised and the bin interior visibly exposed, achieving the requested open state.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · 实际选择 A
A's right arm lifts the red bin lid and retracts, leaving the red bin visibly open; B reaches the red bin but its gripper remains at/in the opening at the final frame, so the release/open state is less complete.

Case Study：拉开笔袋，选中了标记为失败的执行

任务要求拉开笔袋拉链。gpt-6-astra 选择了参考标为失败的一次：它的理由是拉链滑块向近端移动，后方留下开口；对成功的一次，它却认为滑块向远端移动后两侧仍合拢，像是在拉上拉链。

查看模型原文
模型选择参考失败的执行（原文 A）
A moves the zipper slider toward the near end, leaving a visible opening behind it. B pulls the slider toward the far end and leaves the zipper edges joined, appearing to close rather than unzip the case.

2.1.3 质量标签歧义

质量标签需要把不同维度的执行表现压缩为“成功、次优、失败”三档。下面两组偏好分歧涉及“次优”和“失败”的边界：搬运错误对象是否算部分完成，以及完成部分目标但造成洒落应如何评价。gpt-6-astra 的回答识别了这些具体状态，但任务描述与三档标签没有明确各项要求的优先级和扣分尺度。

Case Study：搬错对象算“次优”，未抓起目标算“失败”

任务要求把香蕉从蓝盘移到绿盘。A 把橙色物体搬到了绿盘，香蕉仍留在蓝盘，标签为次优；B 在蓝盘上尝试抓取，但没有抓起并转移香蕉，标签为失败。参考偏好因此为 A，gpt-6-astra 却选择 B，并明确指出两条轨迹都没有完成任务，B 避免了搬运错误对象。

这里的歧义是：对错误对象完成搬运动作，是否应当比未抓起正确对象获得更多质量分？若重视动作流程的完成度，A 完成了抓取、转移和释放；若把对象正确性作为任务进展的前提，A 的这些动作没有推进香蕉转移目标。单一的“次优 > 失败”顺序没有交代这两种标准如何取舍。

查看任务与模型逐字理由
任务原文
Pick up the banana from the blue plate and place it on the green plate
gpt-6-astra · 实际选择 B · 参考偏好 A
Neither execution completes the task: the banana remains on the blue plate in both. A grasps and releases the orange object onto the green plate instead; B makes grasp attempts without a confirmed pickup, but avoids transferring the wrong object.

Case Study：部分倒出并洒落，与尚未倒出如何排序

任务要求把杯中的石子倒到盘子上。A 已倾斜杯子，部分石子落入盘内，同时有石子散落在桌上、仍有石子留在杯中，标签为失败；B 将杯子移到盘子处，但杯子仍直立，石子仍在杯内，标签为次优。参考偏好为 B，gpt-6-astra 选择 A，理由同时提到了倒入盘内的进展与洒落、残留的问题。

这里需要明确任务进展与操作失误之间的权衡：部分石子已经到达目标位置，应得到多少分？洒落和残留又应扣除多少分，是否足以让它排在尚未倒出的执行之后？“次优”与“失败”的边界取决于这些阈值，而三档标签本身没有给出它们。

查看任务与模型逐字理由
任务原文
Pour the pebbles from the cup onto the plate
gpt-6-astra · 实际选择 A · 参考偏好 B
A visibly tips the cup and leaves many pebbles on the plate, though several spill onto the table and some remain in the cup. B grasps and moves the cup onto the plate but leaves it upright with pebbles still inside, without a visible pour.

要让这些质量等级可解释，可以把对象正确性、目标完成度和附带失误分别列为评价判据，再明确哪些是必须满足的条件、哪些允许部分得分。Flora-Rewarder 提供了按 rubric 步骤评分的接口[[cite:flora]]，可用于把这类要求拆开描述。
preference.en:
Direct preference presents two trajectories together and asks the model to choose the better execution. On 1,192 fixed trajectory pairs, gpt-6-astra, GPT-5.6-sol, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash achieve accuracies of 92.4%, 90.7%, and 82.2%, respectively. The gap between gpt-6-astra and GPT-5.6-sol is 1.7 percentage points. As a reference, Robometer reports 82.5% accuracy[[cite:robometer]].

In the following case studies, gpt-6-astra and DeepSeek receive the same task, images, and A/B order.

Case Study: button activation matters more than lingering contact

For this SO101 button-press pair, the actual input order is A: suboptimal; B: successful; reference preference: B. gpt-6-astra selects B and DeepSeek selects A.

B’s input frames show the button lighting up after the gripper presses down, followed by withdrawal; A stays near the button without equally clear activation evidence. gpt-6-astra chooses B based on activation. DeepSeek emphasizes A’s continued contact in the final frame and B’s withdrawal, leading to the opposite choice.

Read both models’ original reasons
gpt-6-astra · Actual choice B
B lowers its gripper onto the button, which visibly lights up, then retracts. A approaches the button but shows no clear depression or activation.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · Actual choice A
In A, the gripper descends onto the button and remains in contact with it at the final frame, indicating a press. In B, the gripper approaches the button but then retracts, leaving the button without clear sustained contact/pressing at the end.

Case Study: opening a lid is not the same as leaving it open

For this Koch red-bin pair, the actual input order is A: failed; B: successful; reference preference: B. gpt-6-astra selects B, matching the reference; DeepSeek selects A, disagreeing with it.

Both inputs show a lid being lifted, but A opens in the penultimate sampled image and closes again in the last one; B’s final image still shows a raised lid and an opening into the bin. gpt-6-astra explicitly identifies A’s lid falling shut. DeepSeek describes A as remaining open and lowers its assessment of B because the gripper remains near the opening.

Read both models’ original reasons
gpt-6-astra · Actual choice B
Both executions lift the correct red bin's lid, but A's lid falls closed again in its final frame. B ends with the lid raised and the bin interior visibly exposed, achieving the requested open state.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · Actual choice A
A's right arm lifts the red bin lid and retracts, leaving the red bin visibly open; B reaches the red bin but its gripper remains at/in the opening at the final frame, so the release/open state is less complete.

Case Study: unzipping the pencil case, but choosing the execution labeled failure

The task asks the robot to unzip the pencil case. gpt-6-astra chooses the execution labeled failure: it says the slider moves toward the near end and leaves an opening behind it. For the successful execution, it instead describes the slider moving toward the far end while the zipper edges remain joined, as if the case were being zipped shut.

Read the original model responses
The model chooses the reference failure (original response A)
A moves the zipper slider toward the near end, leaving a visible opening behind it. B pulls the slider toward the far end and leaves the zipper edges joined, appearing to close rather than unzip the case.

2.1.3 Ambiguity in quality labels

Quality labels compress different dimensions of execution into three categories: successful, suboptimal, and failure. The following two preference disagreements concern the boundary between suboptimal and failure: whether manipulating the wrong object earns partial credit, and how to evaluate partial completion accompanied by spillage. gpt-6-astra identifies these specific states, but the task descriptions and three-level labels do not specify the priorities or penalties attached to each criterion.

Case Study: moving the wrong object is “suboptimal”; failing to pick up the target is “failure”

The task asks the robot to move the banana from the blue plate to the green plate. A transfers the orange object to the green plate while leaving the banana on the blue plate, and is labeled suboptimal. B attempts grasps over the blue plate without picking up and transferring the banana, and is labeled failure. The reference therefore prefers A, whereas gpt-6-astra chooses B, explicitly noting that neither completes the task and that B avoids transferring the wrong object.

The ambiguity is whether completing a transfer with the wrong object should earn more quality credit than failing to pick up the correct object. A completes grasping, transfer, and release when judged by the action sequence. If object correctness is a prerequisite for task progress, those actions do not advance the banana-transfer goal. A single “suboptimal > failure” order does not specify how to reconcile these standards.

Read the task and the verbatim model response
Task instruction
Pick up the banana from the blue plate and place it on the green plate
gpt-6-astra · Actual choice B · Reference preference A
Neither execution completes the task: the banana remains on the blue plate in both. A grasps and releases the orange object onto the green plate instead; B makes grasp attempts without a confirmed pickup, but avoids transferring the wrong object.

Case Study: ranking a partial pour with spillage against no pour

The task asks the robot to pour the pebbles from the cup onto the plate. A tilts the cup and puts some pebbles on the plate, while spilling others onto the table and leaving some in the cup; it is labeled failure. B moves the cup to the plate but leaves it upright with pebbles inside; it is labeled suboptimal. The reference prefers B, whereas gpt-6-astra chooses A, citing both the progress of pouring onto the plate and the spillage and remaining pebbles.

This comparison requires an explicit tradeoff between task progress and execution errors. How much credit should be given for pebbles reaching the target? How much should spillage and incomplete emptying subtract, and should those penalties place A below an execution that has not poured? The boundary between “suboptimal” and “failure” depends on these thresholds, which the three-level labels alone do not provide.

Read the task and the verbatim model response
Task instruction
Pour the pebbles from the cup onto the plate
gpt-6-astra · Actual choice A · Reference preference B
A visibly tips the cup and leaves many pebbles on the plate, though several spill onto the table and some remain in the cup. B grasps and moves the cup onto the plate but leaves it upright with pebbles still inside, without a visible pour.

Interpretable quality levels require separate criteria for object correctness, goal completion, and collateral errors, together with explicit prerequisites and partial-credit rules. Flora-Rewarder provides an interface for scoring individual rubric steps[[cite:flora]], which can be used to describe these requirements separately.

progress.zh:
除了比较整段执行的质量，我们还考察通用多模态模型能否根据任务描述和截至当前时刻的画面，判断任务已经推进到哪一步。在 105 条成功轨迹上，gpt-6-astra、GPT-5.6-sol 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的零样本 VOC 分别为 93.6、93.5 和 89.7。

gpt-6-astra 与 GPT-5.6-sol 的时间相关性接近，两者均高于 DeepSeek；gpt-6-astra 低于 Robometer 报告的 94.8[[cite:robometer]]。

以下为采样帧回放，非原速视频。每次评分仅使用截至当时的观测；空心起点由协议设为 0，连线仅辅助阅读。

Case Study：分清完成、滑落与搬错物体

这组正向案例展示 gpt-6-astra 能识别任务相关的状态差异。同样是“把蓝杯放进水槽”，模型区分了成功放置、杯子滑落和搬错物体，而没有把所有机械臂运动都当作进度。

[[progress-video:Q0041]] [[progress-video:Q0039]] [[progress-video:Q0037]]

成功的一次执行中，gpt-6-astra 在蓝杯仍悬于槽外时给出 0.60，放入并释放后升至 1.00；杯子滑落的一次，到达水槽附近时为 0.55，滑落在槽外后降至 0.40；搬错物体的一次，蓝杯始终没有移动，最终进度回到 0.00。这些升降对应了任务目标的推进或受挫，而非单纯的时间流逝。

查看三次终点判断的模型原文
成功放置 · 1.00
The blue cup is now upright inside the sink basin, and the gripper has withdrawn above it. The instructed placement is complete.
滑落在槽外 · 0.40
The cup has moved next to the sink but appears to have slipped from the gripper and is tilted outside the basin. It is closer to the destination, but must be grasped again and placed inside.
搬错物体 · 0.00
The robot has moved the pale object into the sink, not the blue cup. The blue cup remains unmoved at its initial position on the counter.

Case Study：识别受挫后的重试与完成

任务目标是把香蕉从蓝盘移到绿盘，这条轨迹的质量标签为成功。第一次接近后，香蕉仍在蓝盘，手臂已经退回；gpt-6-astra 的进度由 0.15 降回 0.00。再次接近时，分数回到 0.15；直到最后一次采样观测中香蕉位于绿盘、夹爪离开后，才升至 1.00。模型没有把暂时受挫误当成最终结果，也没有仅凭重新接近就宣告完成。

[[progress-video:T011]]
查看四次预测的模型原文
采样位置 7 · 进度 0.15
The gripper is positioned close above the banana, but the banana remains on the blue plate after the plate was disturbed. No secure pickup or transfer to the empty green plate is visible.
采样位置 15 · 进度 0.00
The arm has withdrawn from the blue plate, losing the earlier close grasping position. The banana remains on the blue plate and the green plate is empty; no pickup or transfer has been achieved.
采样位置 23 · 进度 0.15
The gripper has returned to the banana at the blue plate's edge, providing a close pickup position. The banana is not visibly lifted clear of the plate, and the green plate remains empty.
采样位置 31 · 进度 1.00
The banana is now resting on the green plate, and the gripper has lifted away. The banana is no longer on the blue plate, completing the requested transfer.
progress.en:
Beyond comparing whole executions, we examine whether general-purpose multimodal models can estimate task progress from the instruction and observations available so far. Across 105 successful trajectories, zero-shot VOC is 93.6, 93.5, and 89.7 for gpt-6-astra, GPT-5.6-sol, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, respectively.

gpt-6-astra and GPT-5.6-sol have similar temporal correlations, both above DeepSeek; gpt-6-astra is below Robometer’s reported 94.8[[cite:robometer]].

The following replays show sampled frames, not original-speed video. Each prediction uses only observations available at that point; the hollow initial point is fixed at zero, and lines guide the eye.

Case Study: correctly distinguishing completion, slippage, and the wrong object

These positive cases show gpt-6-astra recognizing task-relevant differences in state. For the same instruction to put the blue cup in the sink, it distinguishes successful placement, a slipping cup, and moving the wrong object, rather than treating all arm motion as progress.

[[progress-video:Q0041]] [[progress-video:Q0039]] [[progress-video:Q0037]]

In the successful execution, gpt-6-astra gives 0.60 while the blue cup is still suspended outside the sink, then raises it to 1.00 after placement and release. In the slipping execution, the score is 0.55 near the sink and falls to 0.40 after the cup slips outside. When the wrong object is moved, the blue cup never moves and the final progress returns to 0.00. These rises and falls correspond to progress toward or setbacks from the task goal, rather than time passing alone.

Read the three original final-step responses
Successful placement · 1.00
The blue cup is now upright inside the sink basin, and the gripper has withdrawn above it. The instructed placement is complete.
Slippage outside the sink · 0.40
The cup has moved next to the sink but appears to have slipped from the gripper and is tilted outside the basin. It is closer to the destination, but must be grasped again and placed inside.
Wrong object · 0.00
The robot has moved the pale object into the sink, not the blue cup. The blue cup remains unmoved at its initial position on the counter.

Case Study: recognizing a setback, a retry, and completion

The task is to move the banana from the blue plate to the green plate, and this trajectory is labeled successful. After the first approach, the banana remains on the blue plate and the arm has withdrawn; gpt-6-astra’s progress falls from 0.15 to 0.00. On the next approach, the score returns to 0.15. It reaches 1.00 only in the final sampled observation, when the banana is on the green plate and the gripper has moved away. The model neither mistakes a temporary setback for the final outcome nor declares completion solely because the robot approaches again.

methods.zh:
RBM看懂执行质量与任务进度

进度估计
机器人执行到当前画面时，任务完成了多少？我们从 105 条成功轨迹中各选取四个时刻，分别向 Astra 提供任务描述、截至该时刻采样的观测图像，以及此前的评分，要求它给出当前任务的完成进度（0–1）并简要说明理由。
轨迹排序
Astra 能否区分不同轨迹的执行质量？我们从每条轨迹中采样八帧图像，与任务描述一起单独输入模型，让它为这条轨迹评分，再按分数从高到低排列。评测共包含 567 条轨迹，用于检验模型给出的排序是否与参考质量顺序一致。
偏好判断
如果直接比较两次执行，Astra 能否选出更好的一次？我们使用 1,192 组固定轨迹对，每组对应同一个任务。从两条轨迹中各采样八帧图像，在同一次请求中交给模型，要求它选出执行得更好的一条。

ROBOFAIL识别并解释失败

子任务诊断
除了判断整体执行质量，我们还希望知道 Astra 能否识别具体子任务中的失败并解释原因。我们使用 RoboFail 中 15 组轨迹对应的 57 个子任务问题，向模型提供关键帧拼图和问题，要求它判断子任务是否成功，并在失败时说明原因。随后在输入中加入五个外部示例，比较零样本和 In-Context Learning（ICL）条件下的表现。
methods.en:
RBMAssessing execution quality and task progress

Progress estimation
How much of the task is complete at the current observation? We select four moments from each of 105 successful trajectories. At each moment, Astra receives the task description, sampled observations up to that moment, and its previous scores. It estimates current completion progress from 0 to 1 and briefly explains its judgment.
Trajectory ranking
Can Astra distinguish the quality of different executions? We sample eight frames from each trajectory and provide them with the task description in a separate request. The model scores each trajectory, and the scores determine the order. The evaluation covers 567 trajectories and checks agreement with the reference quality ordering.
Preference judgment
When comparing two executions directly, can Astra select the better one? We use 1,192 fixed pairs, each for the same task. Eight frames from each trajectory are provided in one request, and the model selects the better execution.

ROBOFAILRecognizing and explaining failures

Subtask diagnosis
Beyond overall execution quality, we ask whether Astra can identify failures in specific subtasks and explain them. We use 57 RoboFail subtask questions from 15 trajectory groups. The model receives a keyframe montage and a question, judges whether the subtask succeeds, and explains a failure. We then add five external examples to compare zero-shot and in-context learning (ICL) conditions.

robofail_results.zh:
我们在 RoboFail[[cite:reflect]] 的 57 个子任务问题上评估 gpt-6-astra，输入为子任务描述和关键帧拼图，输出为 Yes/No 成败判断及文字解释。ICL 条件在待评问题之前加入固定的五个外部图像—问题—参考答案示例；零样本条件不提供示例。

零样本准确率为 64.91%，与专用模型 AHA 的报告结果接近；ICL 后达到 85.96%，比 AHA-13B Vicuna 报告的 66.1% 高约 19.9 个百分点[[cite:aha]]。两种条件的分类计数见下表。
robofail_results.en:
We evaluate gpt-6-astra on 57 RoboFail[[cite:reflect]] subtask questions. Inputs are subtask descriptions and keyframe montages; outputs are Yes/No outcome judgments and textual explanations. ICL prepends a fixed set of five external image–question–reference-answer demonstrations to the test question; zero-shot prompting omits them.

Zero-shot accuracy is 64.91%, comparable to the reported results of the specialized AHA models. With ICL it reaches 85.96%, about 19.9 percentage points above the 66.1% reported for AHA-13B Vicuna[[cite:aha]]. The table below gives classification counts for both conditions.

summary_progress-results.zh: gpt-6-astra 能追踪与任务相关的推进和受挫，但更高的时间相关性不保证更准确的完成判断。
summary_progress-results.en: gpt-6-astra can track task-relevant progress and setbacks, but higher temporal correlation does not guarantee more accurate completion judgments.

summary_failure.zh: 示例减少了对成功执行的误判，但失败漏检反而增加。
summary_failure.en: With examples, fewer successful subtasks are labeled failures, but more failures are missed.

summary_explanations.zh: 综合 ROUGE-L 的提高主要来自成功识别，失败解释项的增幅较小。
summary_explanations.en: Most of the composite ROUGE-L gain comes from success recognition, with a smaller increase in the failure-explanation term.

ranking_icl.zh: 提供三条不同评分水平的参考轨迹后，错序减少但平分增多，Kendall τa 从 0.8166 降至 0.7953，反序率从 4.78% 降至 3.68%，平分率从 8.78% 增至 13.11%。
ranking_icl.en: Providing three reference trajectories at different score levels reduces inversions but increases ties: Kendall τa falls from 0.8166 to 0.7953, the inversion rate falls from 4.78% to 3.68%, and the tie rate rises from 8.78% to 13.11%.

progress_icl.zh:
加入一条相同或相近任务的带阶段评分轨迹后，VOC 从 93.6 升至 94.2，整体时间相关性略有提高。

Case Study：开瓶相关性提高，完成判断退步

零样本下模型认为瓶盖已分离，终点进度为 1.00；单轨迹示例条件下模型判断瓶盖仍在原位，终点进度为 0.35。该条件的 VOC 更高，但 MSE 也更高。

progress_icl.en:
With one reference trajectory from the same or a similar task, annotated with stage scores, VOC rises from 93.6 to 94.2, a small increase in overall time correlation.

Case Study: higher correlation, worse completion judgment

In the zero-shot condition, the model judges the cap to be detached and gives final progress of 1.00; with one reference trajectory, it judges the cap to be still in place and gives final progress of 0.35. The latter condition has higher VOC, but also higher MSE.

analysis_quality-results.zh: 在失败案例中，逆序和平分造成了大部分失分；明确任务成功/质量的具体判据，将更有助于区分模型的失败是来自状态识别错误还是质量评价标准本身的分歧。
analysis_quality-results.en: In the error cases, inversions and ties account for most of the lost credit. Explicit criteria for task success and execution quality would help distinguish errors in state recognition from disagreements about the quality standard itself.

analysis_progress-results.zh: VOC 衡量评分与归一化时间的相关性，但判断任务是否完成，则需要辨认任务完成下的具体状态，两者应分别检验。
analysis_progress-results.en: VOC measures correlation between scores and normalized time. Judging task completion requires recognizing the specific state that constitutes completion, so the two should be evaluated separately.

analysis_failure.zh: 总体准确率的增益主要来自成功子任务的识别。若将评价用于发现执行失败，还需单独考察失败检出率，不能由总体准确率推断。
analysis_failure.en: The gain in overall accuracy comes mainly from recognizing successful subtasks. If the evaluator is used to detect execution failures, failure detection must be assessed separately; overall accuracy alone does not establish how well it does this.

analysis_explanations.zh: 拿刀与旋钮案例说明，判对失败不等于说清失败原因，失败解释还需指出具体的对象、位置或动作问题。
analysis_explanations.en: The knife and knob cases show that detecting failure does not guarantee a correct explanation: the explanation must identify the specific object, location, or action problem.

robofail_icl_summary.zh: RoboFail 的五示例 ICL 使用人工选取并构造的外部示例。我们从原始 RoboFail 的另外五条真实机器人轨迹中各选一个子任务，组成 2 个成功、3 个失败的“图像—问题—答案”示例。五个示例及其顺序在本次 ICL 请求前固定，所有 57 个测试问题均使用同一组示例，不进行参数微调。成败准确率与综合 ROUGE-L 来自同一批回答。
robofail_icl_summary.en: RoboFail’s five-example ICL condition uses external examples selected and constructed manually. We select one subtask from each of five other real-robot trajectories in the original RoboFail dataset, forming two successful and three failed image–question–answer examples. The five examples and their order are fixed before these ICL requests; all 57 test questions use the same examples, without parameter fine-tuning. Outcome accuracy and composite ROUGE-L come from the same responses.

robofail_icl_details.zh:
示例来自 REFLECT 发布的原始 RoboFail 真实机器人记录[[cite:reflect]]。按保存的来源与画面核查，这五条示例轨迹均未出现在 57 个测试问题对应的 15 组轨迹中；没有使用测试图像或测试答案作为示例。该对应关系由我们核查，不是作者发布的官方划分或轨迹映射，也不意味着环境、机器人或预训练数据独立。

固定顺序原始轨迹示例子任务示例答案
1appleInFridge1拿起装有苹果的碗失败：拿了空的蓝碗
2secureObjects1拿起刀成功
3appleInFridge2把装有苹果的碗放进冰箱失败：放在冰箱顶部
4appleInFridge4拿起苹果成功
5heatPotato1打开微波炉加热失败：微波炉门仍开着

三个失败答案由作者的轨迹级失败说明改写，并核对原始画面；两个成功答案来自我们对成功子任务的视觉标注。示例拼图按照作者动作边界从原始 RGB 构造，按时间排列并将未来区域留白。它们不是 AHA 作者发布的原始五示例，具体图像预处理也不保证与 AHA 完全一致。

示例在这次外部五示例请求前固定，未依据本次 ICL 得分搜索或替换；选择时已有零样本结果，因此不属于盲选或预注册抽样。每次请求依次提供五组图像、问题与答案，再提供当前测试问题；57 个测试问题及其原始输入全部保留。
robofail_icl_details.en:
The demonstrations come from the original real-robot RoboFail recordings released with REFLECT[[cite:reflect]]. Our source and visual audit found that none of these five episodes appears among the 15 trajectory groups underlying the 57 test questions; no test images or answers serve as demonstrations. This correspondence is our audit, not an author-released split or identity mapping, and does not establish independence of environment, embodiment, or pretraining data.

Fixed orderSource episodeDemonstrated subtaskDemonstration answer
1appleInFridge1Pick up the bowl containing the appleFailure: picked up the empty blue bowl
2secureObjects1Pick up the knifeSuccess
3appleInFridge2Put the bowl containing the apple inside the fridgeFailure: placed it on top of the fridge
4appleInFridge4Pick up the appleSuccess
5heatPotato1Turn on the microwaveFailure: the door was still open

The three failure answers adapt the authors’ episode-level failure descriptions and were checked against the original frames. The two success answers are our visual annotations of successful subtasks. Demonstration montages use raw RGB frames at author action boundaries, ordered in time with future regions left white. These are not AHA’s original five demonstrations, and exact image preprocessing is not guaranteed to match AHA.

The examples were fixed before this external five-example run and were not searched or replaced based on its ICL scores. Zero-shot results were already available during selection, so this was neither blinded nor preregistered sampling. Each request supplies the five image–question–answer pairs in order, followed by the current test question. All 57 test questions and their original inputs are retained.
